observations.behavior: Adds a new shared-context wiki proposal review and apply capability, including API client, Zod schemas, agent instructions, and a React review component.
observations.code_quote: The user opens **Context > Suggested edits**, selects the edit, reviews the full diff, and selects **Apply to shared wiki**.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a shared, reviewable suggestion workflow for the Context Wiki, replacing the previous requirement that users review the full diff before applying. P1.F1.H1

observations.behavior: Updates agent instructions to use the new proposal workflow and explicitly forbids ordinary tasks from publishing or approving suggestions.
observations.code_quote: Ordinary tasks cannot approve suggestions or publish commit bundles. Do not use scripts/publish for an ordinary task. Tasks can directly update their own channel page with task-context-wiki-page-update; loops can update only their configured channel page. Server-owned nightly maintenance follows its assigned publishing workflow.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes a clear boundary between ordinary tasks and the shared wiki proposal workflow, preventing unauthorized publishing and preserving shared wiki integrity. P1.F2.H1
